parts:

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: Support for running on Oracle Linux
parts:
We haven't tested RRO on Oracle Linux (and I haven't heard any reports of anyone doing so), but if it is indeed compatible with RHEL it may well work as you suggest. If you do try it out, please let us know how it goes here.

Thanks,
# David
